question: How many heads are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM head;

question: How many departments are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM department;

question: How many management records are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM management;

question: List all head names.
sql: SELECT name FROM head;

question: List all department names.
sql: SELECT name FROM department;

question: List heads ordered by age.
sql: SELECT name, age FROM head ORDER BY age;

question: List departments ordered by budget.
sql: SELECT name, budget_in_billions FROM department ORDER BY budget_in_billions DESC;

question: Show the oldest heads.
sql: SELECT name, age FROM head ORDER BY age DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Show the youngest heads.
sql: SELECT name, age FROM head ORDER BY age ASC LIMIT 10;

question: Show departments created after 1950.
sql: SELECT name, creation FROM department WHERE creation > 1950;

question: How many heads are older than 60?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM head WHERE age > 60;

question: How many heads are younger than 40?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM head WHERE age < 40;

question: What is the average age of heads?
sql: SELECT AVG(age) FROM head;

question: What are the minimum and maximum head ages?
sql: SELECT MIN(age), MAX(age) FROM head;

question: What is the average department budget?
sql: SELECT AVG(budget_in_billions) FROM department;

question: What is the total department budget?
sql: SELECT SUM(budget_in_billions) FROM department;

question: Which departments have a budget greater than 50 billion?
sql: SELECT name, budget_in_billions FROM department WHERE budget_in_billions > 50;

question: Which departments have fewer than 10000 employees?
sql: SELECT name, num_employees FROM department WHERE num_employees < 10000;

question: Which departments have between 20000 and 50000 employees?
sql: SELECT name, num_employees FROM department WHERE num_employees BETWEEN 20000 AND 50000;

question: Which departments have a ranking between 10 and 20?
sql: SELECT name, ranking FROM department WHERE ranking BETWEEN 10 AND 20;

question: How many heads were born in each state?
sql: SELECT born_state, COUNT(*) AS head_count FROM head GROUP BY born_state;

question: Which states have at least 4 heads?
sql: SELECT born_state FROM head GROUP BY born_state HAVING COUNT(*) >= 4;

question: Which states have more than 500 heads?
sql: SELECT born_state, COUNT(*) AS head_count FROM head GROUP BY born_state HAVING COUNT(*) > 500;

question: What is the average age for each birth state?
sql: SELECT born_state, AVG(age) AS average_age FROM head GROUP BY born_state;

question: Which birth states have an average age above 50?
sql: SELECT born_state, AVG(age) AS average_age FROM head GROUP BY born_state HAVING AVG(age) > 50;

question: How many departments were created in each year?
sql: SELECT creation, COUNT(*) AS department_count FROM department GROUP BY creation ORDER BY creation;

question: Which creation year has the most departments?
sql: SELECT creation, COUNT(*) AS department_count FROM department GROUP BY creation ORDER BY department_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What is the average employee count by ranking?
sql: SELECT ranking, AVG(num_employees) AS average_employees FROM department GROUP BY ranking ORDER BY ranking;

question: Which rankings have more than 100 departments?
sql: SELECT ranking, COUNT(*) AS department_count FROM department GROUP BY ranking HAVING COUNT(*) > 100;

question: What is the total number of employees by creation year?
sql: SELECT creation, SUM(num_employees) AS total_employees FROM department GROUP BY creation ORDER BY creation;

question: List departments and their heads.
sql: SELECT d.name AS department_name, h.name AS head_name FROM department AS d JOIN management AS m ON d.department_id = m.department_id JOIN head AS h ON m.head_id = h.head_id;

question: List departments and head ages.
sql: SELECT d.name AS department_name, h.name AS head_name, h.age FROM department AS d JOIN management AS m ON d.department_id = m.department_id JOIN head AS h ON m.head_id = h.head_id;

question: Which departments are managed by heads older than 60?
sql: SELECT d.name AS department_name, h.name AS head_name FROM department AS d JOIN management AS m ON d.department_id = m.department_id JOIN head AS h ON m.head_id = h.head_id WHERE h.age > 60;

question: Which heads manage departments with more than 50000 employees?
sql: SELECT h.name AS head_name, d.name AS department_name, d.num_employees FROM head AS h JOIN management AS m ON h.head_id = m.head_id JOIN department AS d ON m.department_id = d.department_id WHERE d.num_employees > 50000;

question: Which departments have heads born in California?
sql: SELECT d.name AS department_name, h.name AS head_name FROM department AS d JOIN management AS m ON d.department_id = m.department_id JOIN head AS h ON m.head_id = h.head_id WHERE h.born_state = 'California';

question: List departments managed by acting heads.
sql: SELECT d.name AS department_name, h.name AS head_name FROM department AS d JOIN management AS m ON d.department_id = m.department_id JOIN head AS h ON m.head_id = h.head_id WHERE m.temporary_acting = 'Yes';

question: How many departments are managed by acting heads?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM management WHERE temporary_acting = 'Yes';

question: What is the average budget of departments managed by acting heads?
sql: SELECT AVG(d.budget_in_billions) FROM department AS d JOIN management AS m ON d.department_id = m.department_id WHERE m.temporary_acting = 'Yes';

question: Show heads and the total employees in their departments.
sql: SELECT h.name AS head_name, SUM(d.num_employees) AS total_employees FROM head AS h JOIN management AS m ON h.head_id = m.head_id JOIN department AS d ON m.department_id = d.department_id GROUP BY h.head_id, h.name;

question: Show departments and their budget per employee.
sql: SELECT d.name, d.budget_in_billions, d.num_employees, d.budget_in_billions / NULLIF(d.num_employees, 0) AS budget_per_employee FROM department AS d;

question: Which departments have more than 50000 employees and a budget below 20 billion?
sql: SELECT name, num_employees, budget_in_billions FROM department WHERE num_employees > 50000 AND budget_in_billions < 20;

question: Which heads manage departments with more than 50000 employees and budgets below 20 billion?
sql: SELECT h.name AS head_name, d.name AS department_name FROM head AS h JOIN management AS m ON h.head_id = m.head_id JOIN department AS d ON m.department_id = d.department_id WHERE d.num_employees > 50000 AND d.budget_in_billions < 20;

question: Which heads manage departments larger than the average department size?
sql: SELECT h.name AS head_name, d.name AS department_name, d.num_employees FROM head AS h JOIN management AS m ON h.head_id = m.head_id JOIN department AS d ON m.department_id = d.department_id WHERE d.num_employees > (SELECT AVG(num_employees) FROM department);

question: Which departments have a budget higher than the average budget?
sql: SELECT name, budget_in_billions FROM department WHERE budget_in_billions > (SELECT AVG(budget_in_billions) FROM department);

question: Which heads are older than the average head age?
sql: SELECT name, age FROM head WHERE age > (SELECT AVG(age) FROM head);

question: Which departments have more employees than the department named Treasury?
sql: SELECT name, num_employees FROM department WHERE num_employees > (SELECT num_employees FROM department WHERE name = 'Treasury');

question: Which heads manage the department with the highest budget?
sql: SELECT h.name AS head_name, d.name AS department_name, d.budget_in_billions FROM head AS h JOIN management AS m ON h.head_id = m.head_id JOIN department AS d ON m.department_id = d.department_id WHERE d.budget_in_billions = (SELECT MAX(budget_in_billions) FROM department);

question: Which states have heads managing departments with more than 50000 employees?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT h.born_state FROM head AS h JOIN management AS m ON h.head_id = m.head_id JOIN department AS d ON m.department_id = d.department_id WHERE d.num_employees > 50000;

question: Show each birth state and its average department budget.
sql: SELECT h.born_state, AVG(d.budget_in_billions) AS average_budget FROM head AS h JOIN management AS m ON h.head_id = m.head_id JOIN department AS d ON m.department_id = d.department_id GROUP BY h.born_state ORDER BY average_budget DESC;

question: Which birth states have at least 100 managed departments and an average department budget above 50 billion?
sql: SELECT h.born_state, COUNT(d.department_id) AS department_count, AVG(d.budget_in_billions) AS average_budget FROM head AS h JOIN management AS m ON h.head_id = m.head_id JOIN department AS d ON m.department_id = d.department_id GROUP BY h.born_state HAVING COUNT(d.department_id) >= 100 AND AVG(d.budget_in_billions) > 50;
